statements.text: From cryptocurrency to AI, new technologies are reshaping our economy. On the Subcommittee on Digital Assets, Financial Technology, and Artificial Intelligence, I will fight to UNLEASH American innovation.

I’m honored to serve on three crucial subcommittees on @FinancialCmte:

💰Capital Markets
💡Digital Assets, Financial Technology, & AI
🔎 Oversight & Accountability

We led the world with the internet. We led the world in space. Now it’s time to lead the world in AI.

That starts with unlocking more energy, building data centers, and unleashing American innovation. President Trump is getting it done. https://t.co/k57pnlMcDk

It was an honor to lead a bipartisan discussion with Sam Altman @sama on the future of AI and what it means for American jobs, security, and competitiveness. 

America MUST win the AI race! https://t.co/0n5Mb2eOx6

China is playing a dirty game on AI, tech, and trade. They’ve stolen our innovations and rigged the system for too long.

It’s time to stop relying on China and start defending American technological leadership. https://t.co/OttUPCLnaC

One of the things that I am working with Democrats on is AI. The biggest challenge right now is the issue of energy. If we're going to beat the Chinese in AI, we need the energy necessary to fuel AI because as you know, it takes nine times more energy than conventional computing.
statements.venue: Interview on The Hill (video page with quoted remarks)

statements.text: One of the things that I have been concerned about— and this goes across the gamut as far as age groups too—are these deep fakes, this idea where AI has used—someone's reputation can be literally eliminated in a day, because there is some type of fake video.
statements.context: Congressman Haridopolos questioning a Google executive at a Financial Services Committee hearing on AI innovation.

statements.text: America is already a global leader in AI, and, to stay that way, we must engage public and private sector individuals to work together to strengthen our technology systems. Americans should heed the call and apply to be a part of the United States Tech Force today! https://t.co/4DOHty41RC

I agree with the President's proposal on we need to be the almost like a Manhattan Project for AI.
